equivalence.method: Unmodified public driver; all retained and proxy vertex coordinates bit-exact. Main visual functions unchanged, apart from separately proven zero-opacity exceptions. UVs and every oriented primitive checked. Opaque-union mode directly checks all source/proxy texture alpha bytes are 255 and preserves expanded per-context source multisets; otherwise expanded source order is exact. A dropped original mask source must be permanently invisible, unclipped and retained in a verified proxy. GPU alpha checked separately.

no_new_quality_loss: Visible mesh programs remain unchanged. Mask proxies concatenate identical geometry programs. Alpha-255 texture coverage is an idempotent union, allowing source order and opaque texture page substitution; the exact per-context primitive multiset, UVs, culling, parent and interpolation are preserved. No Glue.
limits: Relative to Overlap; existing lossy-fit errors remain. Unmodified native Ayagami DX12 timings, not VTS/Core/Editor validation. Hidden proxy geometry is duplicated to trade a small CPU/memory cost for fewer mask draw calls.

independent_timing_trial.note: Same-device alternating poses, both models resident, same full-resolution target/masks, GPU completion included, no readback. Relative diagnostic; two-model residency differs from a single-model host. Desktop not isolated.

repeated_single_model_memory.method: ABBA BAAB; single-model processes; same 65 poses; loading and warmup included; no readback/PNG
